turns.question: I was recently discharged from Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (MIMIC-IV subject 10014354) after an ICU and cardiorenal stay, and my chart combines records from multiple clinics. Please audit my active medications, problem list, and recent labs to identify: (1) any duplicate cholesterol or blood-thinner prescriptions (including brand-name vs. generic), (2) any active heart or kidney medications that conflict with my acute potassium and eGFR lab results or hospital discharge hold instructions, and (3) any conflicting chronic kidney disease (CKD) stages on my active problem list.
